info.bio:
Paul Young (Luton, Bedforshire, Inglaterra, 17 de junio de 1956) es un cantante inglés de música pop.

Paul dio sus primeros pasos en el mundo musical los dió tras unirse a la banda Kat Kool & the Kool Kats, siendo el cantante principal de la banda. Poco tiempo después, se unió a la banda Streetband, donde por primera vez conoció el éxito. Aquí, tuvo un Top 20 Hit en El Reino Unido, con la canción "Toast", alcanzando el lugar #18 en Noviembre de 1978.

scenes.author: Simon Reynolds
scenes.desc: En 1982 el new pop deja de ser un sueño de periodistas: «Don't You Want Me», «Tainted Love» y «The Look of Love» anuncian una nueva invasión, y en 1983 la segunda camada (Duran Duran, Culture Club, Wham!, Eurythmics, Thompson Twins) conquista Estados Unidos gracias a MTV, canal ideado por Michael Nesmith que, sin vídeos americanos, dependía de los británicos, más videogénicos y cultivados en el estilo («I want my MTV»). A Flock of Seagulls, Altered Images («Happy Birthday»), Simple Minds («Promised You a Miracle», New Gold Dream), Haircut 100, Kajagoogoo; Bowie se broncea con «Let's Dance». El new pop reexporta música negra (Chic, P-Funk, Quincy Jones) a la América blanca. En el Reino Unido, 1983 se vive en cambio como un año infausto: reelección de Thatcher, «Kill Ugly Pop» en las paredes y la vuelta de la conciencia social.

podcast.title: Toast (1978) – Novelty B-Side That Became a Hit During the UK Baker's Strike, Launched by Street Band
podcast.body: Released as the B-side to "Hold On" by Street Band, a straight-ahead UK rock group, "Toast" was a song about the joys of making toast, recorded when the band needed filler. During the Baker's Strike of the late 1970s, someone at the BBC discovered the track and put it on air; it became an unexpected quirky hit, but branded the band as novelty artists, leading to their breakup. One member of Street Band was Paul Young, who went on to have major multi-platinum success as a blue-eyed soul singer in the 1980s. "Street Band, with a song called Toast from 1978. Naturally, they were soon branded as a novelty act and they broke up shortly thereafter."

podcast.title: Solo Career Post-Street Band
podcast.body: Following the breakup of Street Band in 1979, keyboardist Paul Young embarked on a successful solo career. He achieved significant success with a series of hit singles throughout the early and middle 1980s. "Save for this one song. And for one member, keyboardist Paul Young went on to a solo career and did very well with the series of hit singles to the early and middle 1980s."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Band Breakup
xref.body: After the success and subsequent liability of "Toast," Street Band released a half dozen more "straight ahead rock and roll singles" which were "miserable failures." The band eventually broke up for good in 1979 and "descended into obscurity," save for the single song "Toast" and keyboardist Paul Young's subsequent solo career. "And Street Band broke up for good in 1979 and descended into obscurity."
